Let $M$ be a bound on the absolute value of every such coefficient.
Fix a power of two $B$ with $B > 2rM^2$, and call $B$ the packing base.
The packed integer of $f$ is $F = \sum_j f_j B^j$
Packing $g$ in the same way gives the integer $G = \sum_j g_j B^j$.

gaps.term: uniqueness of the signed base-B expansion and read-back by balanced remainders
gaps.quote: this signed base-$B$ expansion is unique, so the coefficients can be read back from the integer $FG$
gaps.note: The page asserts uniqueness and read-back without argument. The reader would have to show that the balanced remainder of FG modulo B (in (-B/2, B/2]) equals h_0, and that two expansions with digits below B/2 in size that agree in value agree digitwise. The page gives neither argument.
